import sys

def read_int():
    while True:
        c = sys.stdin.read(1)
        if not c:
            raise ValueError("Input mismatch")
        if not (c == ' ' or c == '\n' or c == '\r' or c == '\t'):
            break
    sgn = 1
    if c == '-':
        sgn = -1
        c = sys.stdin.read(1)
        if not c:
            raise ValueError("Input mismatch")
    res = 0
    while True:
        if c < '0' or c > '9':
            raise ValueError("Input mismatch")
        res = res * 10 + int(c)
        c = sys.stdin.read(1)
        if not c or c == ' ' or c == '\n' or c == '\r' or c == '\t':
            break
    return res * sgn

def read_string():
    while True:
        c = sys.stdin.read(1)
        if not c:
            raise ValueError("Input mismatch")
        if not (c == ' ' or c == '\n' or c == '\r' or c == '\t'):
            break
    res = []
    while True:
        res.append(c)
        c = sys.stdin.read(1)
        if not c or c == ' ' or c == '\n' or c == '\r' or c == '\t':
            break
    return ''.join(res)

def main():
    n = read_int()
    st = read_string()
    c = st

    a1 = 0
    a2 = 0
    cur = 0
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        if c[i] == '(':
            if cur > a1:
                a1 = cur
            cur = 0
            i += 1
            non_empty = False
            while i < n and c[i] != ')':
                non_empty = True
                i += 1
            if non_empty:
                a2 += 1
            if i < n:
                i += 1
        else:
            cur += 1
            i += 1
    if cur > a1:
        a1 = cur

    print(a1, a2)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
